name: CalmSet
description: Information Retrieval (IR) increasingly relies on subjective, graded, and natural-language notions of relevance, motivating the development of reproducible test collections for ranking and recommendation. In affect-sensitive music domains, however, such resources with human-validated relevance signals remain scarce. We introduce CalmSet, a test collection for emotion-tagged music retrieval and recommendation in a therapeutic context for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD).
domain: affective music retrieval for children with asd
